title: TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT and BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to creating a holding account for the Automated Speed Enforcement Program.
text:
[Council File 26-0600-S100]
[Items for which Public Hearings Have Not Been Held - (10 Votes Required for Consideration)]
TRANSPORTATION COMMITTEE REPORT and BUDGET AND FINANCE COMMITTEE REPORT relative to creating a holding account for the Automated Speed Enforcement Program.
Recommendation for Council action:
REQUEST the City Attorney to prepare and present an amendment to Ordinance No. 92382, under Los Angeles Administrative Code Section 5.131 governing the Traffic Safety Fund, as follows:
a. Authorize the deposit of automated traffic and speed safety enforcement system penalties, fines, fees, and associated revenues, including the Automated Speed Enforcement Program citation revenues.
b. Codify the uses of the Automated Speed Enforcement Program revenues consistent with the Assembly Bill (AB) 645 legislation.
c. Designate the Department of Transportation (DOT) as the fund administrator of the Traffic Safety Fund.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
The DOT reports that there is no impact to the General Fund. The July 31, 2026 DOT report recommendation would establish the Traffic Safety Fund as the appropriate special fund for the speed safety system pilot program. California AB 645 requires that speed safety system pilot program revenues be utilized for program cost recovery first, followed by traffic-calming and street-safety improvements.
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
summary: Create a holding account for the Automated Speed Enforcement Program.
